* Encodes a string into a double metaphone value. This Implementation is based on the algorithm by Lawrence * Philips. *

* This class is conditionally thread-safe. The instance field for the maximum code length is mutable * {@link #setMaxCodeLen(int)} but is not volatile, and accesses are not synchronized. If an instance of the class is * shared between threads, the caller needs to ensure that suitable synchronization is used to ensure safe publication * of the value between threads, and must not invoke {@link #setMaxCodeLen(int)} after initial setup. *

* * @see Dr. Dobbs Original Article * @see Wikipedia Metaphone
